narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month} you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. In month {first_bar_apart_month}, {first_bar_apart} was the first score to come apart, the one that measures how long each of you could last with nothing coming in. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost held {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its room to last without a salary stood {safety_gap}.
